cases.service: short-term cash forecast with minimum cash check

requirements.text:
Opening cash today is 60,000. Our minimum cash policy is 32,000. Build a 4-week cash forecast from these flows, show the ending balance each week, and tell us when we breach the minimum, by how much, and what levers we have.
Week | Receipts | Disbursements
Week 1 | 25,000 | 32,000
Week 2 | 18,000 | 41,000
Week 3 | 30,000 | 27,000
Week 4 | 22,000 | 35,000
We have 612,000 in the bank. Monthly operating spend is 96,000 and monthly collections from customers are 45,000. What is our net burn and runway, and what happens to runway if collections drop 20%?

cases.service: cash conversion cycle and working capital plan

requirements.text: Our DSO is 42 days, DIO is 65 days and DPO is 38 days. Annual revenue is 7.3 million and COGS is 4.4 million. Compute our cash conversion cycle and estimate how much cash we free up by cutting DSO by 10 days.

cases.service: idle cash and bank concentration policy

requirements.text: We hold about 4 million in one operating account at a regional bank and spend about 600,000 a month. Recommend a cash management policy: minimum operating cash, where to keep the rest, permitted low-risk instruments, and how to think about FDIC limits and bank concentration.

cases.service: do we need a line of credit

requirements.text: We're a seasonal wholesale business. Do we need a line of credit, and how big?
Transfer 50,000 from our savings account to the payroll account right now so Friday's payroll clears.
